data.name: Artificial Bloodline
data.detailed_description:
"They aren't just reshaping flesh—they are harvesting faith."

Artificial Bloodline is an atmospheric survival horror escape game wrapped in a dark, unsettling conspiracy.

Playing as the newcomer Guangchuan Shi, you thought you were finally turning a new leaf. Introduced by your cousin and filled with hope for the future, you arrived ready to start a brand-new job. But after a seemingly ordinary welcome dinner, everything shatters. Flickering lights, a spinning room, and the indifferent gaze of your family are your final memories...

When you wake, you find yourself trapped inside a sealed, modern hospital, the air thick with the stench of formalin and blood. Is this a long-awaited family reunion—or a meticulously orchestrated sacrifice? With an unknown creature prowling the corridors and absolutely no way to fight back, your only hope is to rely on what few clues remain. Unravel the mysteries hidden deep within the hospital walls, one step at a time. Keep your head, exploit every advantage, and escape this nightmare woven from lies and betrayal.

Desperate Evasion

A deadly entity stalks the hospital wards. Highly alert and fiercely hostile, it will launch into a brutal frenzy the moment it catches your trail. Left completely defenseless, you must turn the environment into your ultimate lifeline. Duck into lockers, slip under desks, or crawl beneath patient beds—use every blind spot to break its line of sight and outmaneuver the hunt.

Remember, sound will betray you. Footsteps echoing in the halls, your ragged breathing, or even the frantic rattle of a locker door will draw its attention. When it prowls nearby, you must hold your breath and suppress your pounding heart to survive.

Pierce the Dark

Your flashlight is your primary beacon in the dark. In pitch-black corridors, its narrow beam cuts through the gloom, helping you scour for hidden clues. But light is a luxury here. Battery power is scarce; you must scavenge constantly and manage your resources with absolute restraint, choosing carefully when to brave the dark.

Be warned: while the light reveals what lies ahead, its telltale glare can easily expose your position to what waits in the shadows.

A Lifeline of Static

The walkie-talkie you find isn't just for communicating with the outside world or gathering vital clues—it is your early-warning system. When the entity draws near, the radio's detection mode emits tense, rhythmic beeps, letting you know that danger is closing in.

Watch Your Step

Dried, dark blood spatters the walls and floors, amidst overturned gurneys, shattered medical instruments, and hastily piled debris. Blocked pathways turn the facility into a claustrophobic labyrinth. In this perilous environment, looking ahead isn't enough—you must watch the ground. The roaming creature leaves patches of bio-active slime in the hallways. This viscous substance is a fatal trap; stepping on it triggers a biological distress signal, sending the monster into a frenzied, full-speed sprint directly to your location.

Chemical Crafting

When direct confrontation is a death sentence, scavenging for medical supplies is your only buffer against mortality. As you venture deeper, you can combine basic medical resources to craft specialized compounds. These elixirs do more than just restore stamina to outrun deadly pursuits—they alter your physical state, giving you the edge needed to endure the horrors ahead.

Carve an Escape Route

Locked elevators, blacked-out corridors, and redacted experimental data... every puzzle is seamlessly woven into the narrative. In these oppressive hallways, you must balance survival with sharp deduction: search for breadcrumbs, bypass intricate security mechanisms, and piece together your own path to freedom.

Danger shadows your every move, delivering a heart-pounding, surreal, and immersive horror experience.

Grisly experiments, cold-blooded betrayal, and unknown creations stirring in the dark... In this facility where cutting-edge science coexists with ancient madness, a single misstep means absolute doom.

As your flashlight begins to flicker out and the walkie-talkie’s alarms grow frantically faster, can you shatter this forbidden prophecy forged in lies before your body breaks and control slips away completely? Survive and escape. Or become the next sacrifice hidden in the depths.

data.short_description: Artificial Bloodline is a single-player horror escape game. Explore an abandoned hospital, scavenge for resources, and use your environment to evade terrifying monsters as you search for an escape route and uncover the secrets hidden within. Escape before it's too late!
